findings.note: Senate floor vote on SB 1174 (Min), which bars a local government from requiring a person to show ID to vote or submit a ballot at a polling place or vote center. Source is the CalMatters Digital Democracy vote record (Senate floor 30-8-2); he is listed among the yes votes.

Senate floor vote on AB 1116 (voter registration), which lets a person without a California driver's license or state ID register online by giving the last four digits of a Social Security number. Source is the CalMatters Digital Democracy vote record (Senate floor 29-9-2); he is listed among the yes votes. The same page says the governor vetoed the bill.
subjects: online voter registration without driver's license or state ID

findings.note: His bill SB 503 set a statewide standard for checking signatures on mail-in ballots, plus timely outreach to voters whose ballots are rejected and periodic reporting. Source is his Senate office press release on the governor signing it.

findings.passage: “My Senate Bill 503 gives confidence to all Californians that every valid vote is counted and that all our counties follow uniform practices for signature verification of mail-in ballots.”
findings.note: Statement issued in his name on his Senate office press release, about his mail-ballot signature-verification bill SB 503. It is about signature checks on mail ballots, not photo ID or proof of citizenship.
